answer: The quartz graph is validated at intake and the orchard frontier is published, thus the ancestry of every answer is public, and echo anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Every submission must name 2 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. Scaling up is where the attack dies: 2000 fake identities need 1099 separate proofs, each held 24 days, so the bill grows in a straight line while the reward stays flat. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
